# Interactive Brokers

> > Interactive Brokers (IBKR) is a global electronic brokerage platform offering low-cost trading, margin financing, and institutional services across stocks, options, bonds, mutual funds, and derivatives.

IBKR provides award-winning trading platforms including Trader Workstation, Client Portal, and IBKR Desktop, serving individual investors, hedge funds, money managers, and institutional clients. The platform features advanced tools like Probability Lab, order types and algos, plus specialized programs including Stock Yield Enhancement and introducing broker solutions.

## Key Topics

- IBKR Trading Platforms
- Margin Trading & Financing
- Order Types & Trading Algos
- Stock Yield Enhancement Program
- Probability Lab
- Institutional Accounts

- Fixed Income & Bonds
- Options Trading

## Trading Platforms & Tools

- [IBKR Trading Platforms](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/trading-platforms.php): Award-winning platforms: Client Portal, Trader Workstation, IBKR Desktop
- [Order Types and Algos](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/ordertypes.php): 100+ order types and trading algos for risk management and execution
- [Probability Lab](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/general/education/probability_lab.php): Probability Lab: options analysis tool with distribution builder

## Margin & Pricing

- [Margin Rates and Financing](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/margin-rates.php): Tiered margin rates and financing costs with benchmark comparisons
- [Margin Trading](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/margin.php): Margin trading with lowest loan rates, benefits, and requirements
- [Short Sale Cost](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/pricing/short-sale-cost.php): Stock borrow fees and short selling cost estimation guide
- [Stock Yield Enhancement Program](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/pricing/stock-yield-enhancement-program.php): Earn income by lending fully-paid shares through securities lending

## Trading Products & Markets

- [Bonds Marketplace - Fixed Income](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-bonds.php): Fixed income trading: corporate, government, municipal bonds with no markups
- [Mutual Funds Marketplace](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-mutual-funds.php): 40k+ mutual funds marketplace with no custody fees and search tools
- [Stock, Bond & Options Global Outsourced Trading Desk](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/pdfhighlights/PDF-OptionsDesk.php): Global outsourced trading desk for stock, bond, and options blocks

## Institutional & Professional Accounts

- [Hedge Fund](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/accounts/hedge-fund.php): Hedge fund services: trading, clearing, custody, and reporting solutions
- [Money Manager](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/accounts/money-manager.php): Money manager accounts for wealth managers with multi-client interface
- [Broker](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/accounts/broker.php): Introducing broker solutions: trading, clearing, reporting, no contract
- [Non-Professional Advisors](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/accounts/non-professional-advisor.php): Non-professional advisor accounts with multi-account management tools
- [Compliance Officer](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/accounts/compliance-officer.php): EmployeeTrack for compliance officers: global employee investment tracking

## Account Information & Support

- [Account Guide](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/accounts/account-guide.php): Account selection guide: Individual, Joint, IRA, Trust with currencies
- [Support for Individual Accounts](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/support/individuals.php): Support hub for individual accounts: guides, FAQs, and phone assistance
